checks.name: Authoritative endpoint and age policy
checks.evidence: EntranceRouting.Configure requires known compiled endpoints and reviewed policy rows, rejects unsupported policy revisions, and rejects zero source/arrival-age overlap. Native policy explicitly uses child=1/adult=2 instead of reversed engine enum ordinals.

checks.name: Coupled reverses remain atomic
checks.evidence: Configure still requires map[reverse(destination)] == reverse(source) for each paired route and commits only after validating the complete map. Jabu local carrier door identities remain required.

checks.name: Actual resolver marker; previews remain harmless
checks.evidence: Record arms only mapped or otherwise age-unsafe actual physical sources. SavewarpForAge, physical door resolution and recovery explicitly arm actual requests. Grotto_GetEntranceValueHandlingGrottoRando uses peek=true; it cannot arm or finalize pending arrivals. ResolvedArrival finalizes only the matching target and records concrete native base mismatch.

checks.name: Fade table access is protected before scene init
checks.evidence: z_play TRANS_MODE_SETUP calls Archipelago_EntranceTransitionLayer before indexing gEntranceTable[nextEntranceIndex+sceneLayer]. Only the exact pending resolved AP arrival in normal game mode gets ordinary layer0 for this fade lookup. A mismatched resolver output is held at the reviewed native base until recovery.

checks.name: Inherited cutscene state and destination story events
checks.evidence: Play_Init consumes nextCutsceneIndex, then invokes BeforeSceneInit before Cutscene_HandleConditionalTriggers. BeforeSceneInit verifies actual age, source mask and all four current native table rows, then clears inherited current/next cutscene and trigger. AfterSceneConditions preserves newly scheduled cutscene, entrance or game-mode changes. Boss intro hooks after scene spawn remain untouched.

checks.name: Bounded rejection recovery and check provenance
checks.evidence: RecoverRejectedArrival considers the physical source reverse, current-age configured spawn, and ordinary Link house doorway in a fixed three-element loop. Every candidate must permit actual age and match all four native scene/spawn rows. It clears old crossing/check history and resolves the fallback once without reapplying the shuffle mapping to a reverse. If no candidate validates, scene loading stops via Opening instead of indexing unverified scene data.

checks.name: Grotto return base and respawn position remain compatible
checks.evidence: ResolvedArrival canonicalizes actual grotto-return targets to their reviewed native base and respawnFlag2. Existing RETURN room/position data remains intact for natural coupled exits; explicit grotto returns set reviewed native return coordinates beforehand. z_room uses positive respawnFlag to select saved room, and player respawn restores saved position. Room doors resolve to anchor plus separate reviewed room/position overrides.

checks.name: Normal source variants and live map lifecycle
checks.evidence: Native HF/Zora River water aliases use canonical AP source identity while preserving the original native lookup input. Unmapped ordinary water arrivals remain vanilla. Changed maps cancel pending transitions; unchanged map reapplication avoids resetting live grotto state. OnLoadGame cancels stale requests before Entrance_Init and a fresh savewarp request; game exit and explicit water-recovery cancellation clear stale arrivals.

checks.name: Savewarp and active child blue-warps
checks.evidence: SavewarpForAge arms the chosen dedicated age spawn and resolves through the same real grotto/door resolver; BetterSaveMenu calls it only after Return to Spawn and selecting age. ServicePendingSpawn restores the outgoing current entrance until transition commit. Entrance_ReplaceChildTempleWarps applies all five reviewed repairs when AP routing is active, independently of ordinary dungeon/boss shuffle options.

scope: Read-only independent review of actual native production source and call paths. This report does not claim a complete native build, ROM scene geometry validation, or in-game playback. Focused compiled runtime fixtures are owned and reported separately by the native implementation agent.
